mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article_view_daily (article_id, stat_date, view_count) VALUES (#{articleId}, #{statDate}, #{viewCount}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = VALUES(view_count)
mapper.select: SELECT v.article_id AS article_id, a.title AS title, a.slug AS slug, SUM(v.view_count) AS period_view, COALESCE(a.view_count, 0) AS total_view FROM article_view_daily v LEFT JOIN article a ON a.id = v.article_id WHERE v.stat_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY v.article_id, a.title, a.slug, a.view_count ORDER BY period_view DESC, total_view DESC, v.article_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
